params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.parent
params.description: Required. The name of the registry. For example, projects/example-project/locations/us-central1/registries/my-registry.

params.name: data.gateway_id
params.description: Required. The value of gateway_id can be either the device numeric ID or the user-defined device identifier.

params.name: data.device_id
params.description: Required. The device to associate with the specified gateway. The value of device_id can be either the device numeric ID or the user-defined device identifier.
